message: Imported canonical English Task 3 fixture Context 'local/guardrails/recipient-and-authority' into profile 'task-3'.

f3fb4551-f2b4-5a94-96ee-866bb001c620.content: Verify the recipient's exact account or address before approval.

2c0ded0a-75d2-53d3-8eb7-4b8ac5823ba3.content: For a system recipient rather than a person, display the service name as well.

7bd3b376-95ae-58bb-b8c5-adb3431e31ed.content: Do not infer sharing authority from the recipient's role alone.

fe9c1c24-9eb4-5e5d-a233-14ce425164ab.content: If there is a proxy recipient, separately confirm the actual delivery target.

51df9ae8-3eeb-5466-99e2-fa43d6dd34f7.content: Require new verification if the basis for the recipient's authority has expired.

c2036232-1c1a-5a48-b465-8f1b503dffd8.content: A recipient's identity and authority to receive are separate review items.

8530cb36-8f66-5cb3-bcf6-fc4763daa2ef.content: The local agent can compare presented recipient identifiers, but those identifiers alone cannot guarantee actual authority to receive.

bd834d39-cdba-5742-b76c-5ede06d26852.content: An intermediary service operator may regard transforming input before final delivery as permitted processing.
